gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-multani: Starborn spaces its letters far apart and lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, ethereal and dreamy. Noto Sans Multani, lofty and open-tailed, gives it steady footing.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Starborn floats its letters in big pockets of blank space, while its heavy lowercase stripe anchors every line. Noto Sans Myanmar, sturdy and broad-mouthed, is the one built for running text.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-nabatae: Lowercase that stands almost as tall as the capitals gives Noto Sans Nabataean a bold, upright look, with wide-open s curves. Starborn earns its keep large and brief, where its dreamy spacing can breathe.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-nag-mun: Starborn scatters its letters across wide gaps, and its dark lowercase stripe gives every line a dreamy weight. gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-nandina: Starborn lets whole lines glow with wide gaps and a thick, dark stripe of lowercase. Noto Sans Nandinagari handles the smaller text, so a modest heading size with room around it would let the generous sans openings do their work.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-newa: Starborn is all drifting space and one thick, dark lowercase band, ethereal from the first word. But Noto Sans Newa is the sharp counterpoint, its open-mouthed e and tall bowls making the pair feel dreamy and grounded at once.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Dreamy, drifting, dark-striped. Starborn stretches its letters across blank space, while Noto Sans Nushu holds its terminals far from the stroke under a towering x-height, which makes the pair feel like airy mist over crisp print.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Starborn spaces its letters widely and runs a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line. Noto Sans Ogham, with wide gaps in the e and tall bodies that look bold, makes a long stretch of text feel crisp and sturdy.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-ol-chik: Words in Noto Sans Ol Chiki read as solid blocks rather than skylines, their curve tails held well back from the body. Starborn, ethereal and dreamy beside it, loosens that firmness with wide spaces and a dark lowercase stripe.
